in_marathi.name: Nandkisor
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sweet, Delightful, Joyful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandkisor हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nand' meaning joy, happiness and 'Kisor' meaning delightful or charming. It is a name that signifies the presence of joy and delight in one's life.
